calibration_mean_response.csv.level: mean of five charge curves on their common grid
calibration_mean_response.csv.channel_count: five selected curves, including the channel-29 record with unresolved zero-bias alias

pedestal_channel_statistics.csv.pedestal_adc: mean of the 100 provided event samples for each channel
pedestal_channel_statistics.csv.common_mode_corrected_sample_noise_adc: sample standard deviation of residuals after pedestal and event common-mode subtraction, using N-1
pedestal_channel_statistics.csv.event_count: number of matrix columns, not inferred from export histogram bins

source_voltage_response.csv.bias_voltage_v: voltage parsed into selected manifest from original voltage-specific filenames
source_voltage_response.csv.cluster_count: number of observed cluster data rows, not acquisition-event count
source_voltage_response.csv.contributing_channel_count: number of all listed channel ADC entries
source_voltage_response.csv.historical_mean_first_channel_adc: mean of first listed ADC entry of each cluster, the report-matched historical reduction
source_voltage_response.csv.mean_cluster_sum_adc: mean of per-cluster sums of all contributing channel signals, following the manual
source_voltage_response.csv.normalized_historical_mean_first_channel: (value-series minimum)/(series maximum-series minimum); relative signal, not absolute efficiency
source_voltage_response.csv.normalized_mean_cluster_sum_adc: same min-max transformation of mean cluster sums

large_source_adc_spectrum.csv.lower_edge_adc: lower edge of one of 150 equal-width bins over observed cluster-sum range
large_source_adc_spectrum.csv.upper_edge_adc: upper edge; bins are left-closed/right-open except final maximum included
large_source_adc_spectrum.csv.count: number of summed-ADC clusters in bin

large_source_signal_summary.csv.cluster_count: observed cluster rows, not number of acquisition events
large_source_signal_summary.csv.mean_cluster_sum_adc: arithmetic mean of per-cluster ADC sums
large_source_signal_summary.csv.standard_error_mean_adc: sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(cluster_count), conditional on treating clusters as independent; systematic uncertainty unassessed

large_source_observed_cluster_sizes.csv.channel_count: number of entries in each observed cluster row
large_source_observed_cluster_sizes.csv.count: number of clusters with that many contributing channel entries
